statement: Choose the same observed time generator xi/tau_obs used by the Hamiltonian/Gauss charge and slow-orbit readout.
derivation_or_meaning: If the mass projector uses a different time, M_H,total can differ from the orbital monopole by a frame/readout residual.

statement: Define J_M,total^a[xi] := -(T_total^{a}{}_{b} xi^b)/c^2 for the descended total Hilbert stress T_total=T_matter+T_EM+T_binding+T_apparatus+T_int.
derivation_or_meaning: This is the total active mass-energy current. EM/Poynting is included through T_EM, not by adding a separate fifth-force charge.

statement: Pi_M_total maps a q_obs source history to M_H,total[W,Sigma,xi] = int_{Sigma cap D_total(W)} n_a J_M,total^a[xi] dSigma plus declared finite tail terms that are not cut by D_total.
derivation_or_meaning: The projector is a bookkeeping map from total stress to monopole source charge; it is not an empirical fit of GM.

statement: D_total must include matter support, descended EM field support assigned to the source, binding/interaction support, apparatus/readout support, and source/theta normalization support up to a boundary where total flux is zero or bounded.
derivation_or_meaning: This prevents matter-only cuts from manufacturing Q_EM_Poynting or Q_source_theta.

statement: Any stress included in M_H,total must be removed from mu_extra; any stress not included must stay in a named Q_i row with a bound.
derivation_or_meaning: The same field energy cannot be both source mass and extra monopole.

statement: If xi is stationary/Killing in the local exterior, total source descent holds, parent exchange is silent, and the total-domain side flux vanishes, then d(Pi_M_total J_M,total)=0 outside the chosen total source.
derivation_or_meaning: This is the bridge from source projector to Hamiltonian/Gauss equality.

statement: If PIM3777_1 through PIM3777_5 are parent-signed and the 3773 Hamiltonian/Gauss charge equality uses Pi_M_total, then mu_obs=G_eff M_H,total up to the remaining non-total-source Q_i channels.
derivation_or_meaning: This is the constructive measured-GM route after rejecting matter-only mass.
